stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class): 24,776 applied, 18,152 admitted (73%), 1,601 enrolled (1,600 full-time + 1 part-time); counts from the NCES IPEDS 2025 Data Feedback Report, Figure 1 (chart data), and College Navigator shows the same 24,776 applicants, 73% admitted and 9% of admitted students enrolled. No Common Data Set found: Seton Hall's Institutional Research reports page links only the 2002-2005 editions, so the international split, GPA distribution, waitlist, early-round counts and admission factors (CDS-only items) are left blank. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (400 students = 25% sent SAT, 85 = 5% sent ACT); Seton Hall is test-optional through the fall 2029 cycle. College Navigator gives no combined SAT total. Undergraduate enrollment (6,146) and the 104 U.S. nonresident undergraduates are IPEDS fall 2024 (College Navigator shows nonresidents as 2% of undergraduates); the 14-to-1 student-to-faculty ratio is from College Navigator. Calendar is semester (the bursar page bills tuition per semester).
